cohort: 150 pregnant women with early onset pre-eclampsia between 26-34 weeks gestation at Nilofer Hospital for Women and Children, Hyderabad, Telangana
finding: Early onset pre-eclampsia is associated with serious maternal and fetal complications, with a high cesarean section rate (69%) and a maternal mortality rate of 4%.
mod_finding: Fetal outcome was unaffected by mode of delivery.
followup_time: Length of hospital stay (7-31 days, average 16 days)
